passif.nom: Guardians of the Earth and Forest
passif.description:
Increases basic stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] participating in battle by [FFAE00]15%[-], [FFAE00]each[-] hero increasing all stats of the hero duo by [FFAE00]7%[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Ally: Fairies, Giants, [The Seven Deadly Sins][/i][-]

At the start of the allies' turn, [00D5FF]Wrath of the Earth[-] is applied to enemies that do not have [00D5FF]Wrath of the Earth[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Wrath of the Earth: Accumulates up to [FFAE00]400,000[-] of the target's damage taken.[/i][-]

At the start of the battle, [00D5FF]Giant Queen's Protection[-] is applied to the hero duo and [00D5FF]Suppress Damage Taken[-] is applied to [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Giant Queen's Protection: HP-related stats [FFAE00]+20%[-]
Immune to Petrify.
※Suppress Damage Taken: Damage taken from enemy skills does not exceed [FFAE00]50%[-] of Max HP.[/i][-]

Whenever an enemy reaches the maximum [00D5FF]Wrath of the Earth[-] value, the hero duo gains [FFAE00]1[-] [00D5FF]Wrath of the Fairy King[-] effect, up to a maximum of [FFAE00]3[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Wrath of the Fairy King: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]+7%[-], damage taken [FFAE00]-40%[-]
(Stacks [FFAE00]5 times[-])[/i][-]

When the hero duo uses an [00D5FF]all-target attack[-] other than their Ultimate Move on an enemy with the [00D5FF]Wrath of the Earth[-] effect, the enemy takes additional damage equal to [FF8000]40%[-] of the accumulated value.

[FFAE00]1[-] [00D5FF]Wrath of the Fairy King[-] effect is removed [00D5FF]each time the hero duo takes damage[-] from an enemy's skill during the enemy's turn.

If there is a [00D5FF]Petrified[-] enemy, [00D5FF]Applicable Allies'[-] final damage taken from enemy skills decreases by [FF8000]50%[-].
